newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FedEx confirms increases China Links.
newsitem.headline: FedEx confirms increases China Links.

text.p: Federal Express Corporation said it has extended its U.S.-China and China-Asia service to four direct flights weekly.
The all-cargo flights will link U.S.cities, Beijing and Shanghai directly with the company's AsiaOne network and its Asian hub at Subic Bay in the Philippines, it added in a statement.
The McDonnell Douglas DC-10 overnight delivery service which was launched in March 1996 now links 13 major Asian cities, it said.
John Quinn, Fedex vice president for China and Mid-Pacific region was quoted as saying that Fedex has aggressive expansion plans in China and now serves 73 cities in China for pick-up and delivery.
